verdict.rationale: First-party docs show users can upload or attach notes in Word and data in Excel for analysis (copilot-docs-1, copilot-docs-16). Analyst and code execution turn raw numbers into insights, calculations and graphs (copilot-docs-6, copilot-docs-31). Connectors can find and summarize files, including PDFs, from OneDrive and Google Drive (copilot-docs-39, copilot-docs-43), and one community user praises cross-document data fetching in 365 (copilot-comm-7). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of direct PDF upload and analysis in chat, any evidence on accuracy of the analysis, and in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of file-analysis quality.
